FAQ

Answers before you browse.

Clear explanations of the product-link, warehouse, QC and parcel stages—without promising outcomes that depend on a specific order.

Common questions

Use the database with confidence.

What is the basic LoloBuy order flow?

Start with a supported marketplace product link, confirm the listing choices, submit the order, then wait for the seller to send the item to the warehouse. International shipping is a later, separate parcel decision.

Does seller-to-warehouse shipping mean the item is on its way internationally?

No. Domestic delivery to the warehouse and international shipment are separate stages. International options become relevant after the warehouse receives the item.

What should I check before paying for an item?

Review the active listing: variant, size, colour, quantity and seller details. Keep a short note of the option you selected so you can compare it later.

What can QC photos help me check?

When available, they can help you compare visible details, labels, colour, construction and the received variant with your original choice. They are evidence, not a guarantee of quality, fit or delivery.

Can I combine items into one parcel?

Items can be stored while you decide whether to combine eligible products. Review the weight, dimensions, item type, destination restrictions and current shipping choices before submission.

How should I choose an international shipping line?

Use the options and conditions currently shown for your own destination and parcel. Prices, availability and processing times may change, so do not rely on old screenshots or another buyer’s route.

Can shipping time be guaranteed?

No. Carrier handling, destination processing, customs and parcel details can change the timeline. Use the current tracking record once dispatch has happened.

What should I never post publicly?

Do not post account data, payment screenshots, names, addresses, order IDs, parcel IDs or full tracking numbers. Use the official support route for account-specific matters.

Where do searches on this site open?

They open in the FindSpreadsheet live search so you can continue with the current database results.

Is this the official LoloBuy website?

No. This is an independent product-discovery site. It provides general research guidance and directs visitors only to FindSpreadsheet.
